Senses.Explanation: To inherit lineage transmission is to be recorded as succeeding to a named teacher or as belonging among that teacher’s transmission heirs. The phrase occurs in biographies, succession statements, title credits by successor-disciples, and direct discussion of the consequences of succeeding a monastery founder. Narrated succession is attributed to its compiler while the successor and teacher remain contextual figures.
Senses.Note: The frozen corpus has 1,738 exact hits in 262 files representing 257 works. Seven anchors cover biography, inscription, case commentary, successor credits, collective heirs, and direct discussion across independent works.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compiler narration. The Continued Record of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), in Tianyi Yihuai's biography, says that an unnamed group of lineage heirs was very numerous. ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The compiler narrates that many people inherited Tianyi Yihuai’s lineage.
